display_name: 源跨视图频段平衡同记录检索诊断
description: 比较普通 IQ 与四频段归一化在已冻结源记录同记录检索中的表现，不使用身份标签。

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split permitted source L_s/U_s
data.representation: 4096 held-out source physical IDs x three views and their aligned clean IQ; 4096-reference bank

permissions.claim_scope: Source same-record retrieval only; not TX identity accuracy or deployable inference

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed DURA source context only; no fitting or saved model
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Source context schema, source view order, distinct 32768 source fit IDs and no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original DURA and source IQ context are F/TX/V/target free
checkpoint.selection_rule: Predefined ordinary and balanced features with source-fit-only noise quartiles; no target

expected_artifacts: result.json: aggregate source top1/top5 retrieval, tie counts and noise groups

rows.method: Ordinary and four-band-normalized source IQ cosine retrieval
rows.purpose: Assess a no-label same-record proxy for frequency balancing, not transmitter identity
rows.seed_notes: No new randomness; deterministic source physical-ID-index modulo 8 split
rows.scenario: 4096 aligned source records x three simulated views
expected_artifacts: result.json: aggregate source top1/top5 retrieval, tie counts and noise groups

notes: Source physical ID index modulo 8 equals zero defines 4096 records; clean is aligned across views.
Noise thresholds use only remaining source IDs; no model fitting, F/TX/V/target access or saved model.
Ranking is optimistic on exact ties, which are counted separately.
Same-record matching may exploit content or receiver characteristics and is not TX identity; clean bank unavailable at deployment.
